notes.title: Trailer, new screenshots and a few words about the game
notes.notes:
Welcome to the [b]Mask of Sanity[/b] page!
I would like to thank you for the interest to my project. This game is produced by
one person. I do my best to make this game of a high quality.
[b]Mask of Sanity[/b] is the Survival, Horror, Thriller first person game. The main hero is a private investigator Tom Bailey. His life is totally changed during the investigation of a mysterious murder.
At the same time a lovely town Providence has become a spine-chilling place, where people literally turned into aggressive beasts. The player must understand
is there any link between the murder and events, that caused a massive insanity of citizens...
P.S. I made a trailer and some new screenshots.
